scope: feature source diff, publication/access/isolation/protocol/native installation, followed by both fixes

findings.problem: Reconnect after candidate snapshot could still be deleted
findings.resolution: Delete rechecks connection and expiry; returned removal count reflects actual deletion

findings.problem: Rollback exception escaped the callback/timer and retained pending persistence
findings.resolution: Common failure handler catches restoration error and always resets pending state; accurately reports failure

ScriptGenerator/Library mutations retain memory and disk when storage throws

findings.problem: Valid examples may omit controls; room handoff could throw reading teams
findings.resolution: Materialize core and manifest defaults while preserving supplied values; reuse core domains and display labels
tests: OnlineScreenLifetime/generator examples with omitted controls use engine defaults when selecting a room

deployment: Existing bounded tmpfs and Bubblewrap support startup probes; no new runtime dependency or configuration required
